WITH s AS (
 SELECT f.*, p.category, p.subcategory FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
 WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2025-07-27' AND p.category='Garden'),
r AS (SELECT sales_line_id, sum(quantity_returned) rq, sum(refund_net) rn, count(*) n FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1)
SELECT s.subcategory, s.staff_purchase_flag, s.channel_code,
 count(*) lines, sum(s.quantity) units, sum(s.net_amount) net, sum(case when s.quantity<=0 or s.net_amount<=0 then 1 else 0 end) nonpos,
 sum(coalesce(r.rq,0)) ret_units, sum(coalesce(r.rn,0)) ret_net,
 sum(case when r.rq > s.quantity then 1 else 0 end) over_ret, sum(case when r.rn > s.net_amount+0.01 then 1 else 0 end) over_val,
 count(r.sales_line_id) ret_lines
FROM s LEFT JOIN r USING (sales_line_id)
GROUP BY ROLLUP(s.subcategory), s.staff_purchase_flag, s.channel_code ORDER BY 1,2,3

WITH sold AS (
  SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.quantity, f.net_amount, p.subcategory
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key = f.store_key
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2025-07-27'
    AND p.category = 'Garden' AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag AND st.store_id <> 999),
ret AS (SELECT sales_line_id, sum(quantity_returned) q, sum(refund_net) v FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1)
SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 1 AS fiscal_quarter, s.subcategory,
  round(100.0 * sum(coalesce(r.v,0)) / sum(s.net_amount), 2) AS return_rate_pct,
  round(100.0 * sum(coalesce(r.q,0)) / sum(s.quantity), 2) AS units_rate_pct,
  round(100.0 * sum(coalesce(r.v,0)) / sum(s.net_amount) , 4) raw_val
FROM sold s LEFT JOIN ret r USING (sales_line_id) GROUP BY s.subcategory ORDER BY s.subcategory
